name: Necromancer Hoarfrost Hands lengthens Lichfrost's slow by 4 sec and adds 4% hit (#748)
contract: Hoarfrost Hands 803291 is a Rime talent (CharacterAdvancement 6488, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab 60, TalentEssenceCost 1) whose description reads 'Increases the duration of Lichfrost's movement speed slow by $/1000;s1 sec and your hit chance by $s2%.' Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) MiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), BasePoints 3999 + DieSides 1 = 4000 ms, EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 0x8000000) in SpellFamilyName 29, which matches every Lichfrost rank (801722 and 501969-501980, family flags 0, 0, 0x8000000; the same flag AscensionNecromancer::Lichfrost tests). Lichfrost's only aura is its effect 2 MOD_DECREASE_SPEED slow; rank 1 801722 has DurationIndex 27 = 3000 ms. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HIT_CHANCE_ALL_PCT (333), BasePoints 3 + DieSides 1 = 4, which Player::UpdateMeleeHitChances and UpdateSpellHitChances add to the melee and spell hit modifiers. The talent has no ProcFlags, so its ProcChance 20 is inert. Aura::CalcMaxDuration applies the caster's SPELLMOD_DURATION, so the Lichfrost slow must land with 3000 ms before the talent and 7000 ms after it, and both hit modifiers must rise by exactly 4.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
CONTROL: the slow lasts 3 sec without the talent
SETUP: the second Lichfrost slows the golem
DISCRIMINATING: the slow lasts 7 sec with the talent
The lengthened slow is still active after 4 sec
